notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (User-agent: * / Allow: /) fully open, no Claude-specific block; tier (a) direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome + requests), never needed tier (b)/(c). TREE: built via union of homepage nav links plus each category page's own breadcrumb/subcategory-strip links, confirmed on every leaf via canonical link and h1 matching the requested node. Main branches walked: /rugs--textiles/ (Textile home), /cookware--kitchen-accessories/kitchen-linens--towels/ (Textile, kitchen linens), /home-accessories/bathroom-accessories/ (shower-curtains=Textile, laundry-baskets=Storage), /furniture/storage--shelves/ (Storage, mixed with Furniture), /home-accessories/home-storage--organisers/ (Storage), /cookware--kitchen-accessories/kitchen-storage/ (Storage). QTY: exact value from each page's embedded JSON pagination block (pagination.total), cross-checked against the rendered 'Showing X of N products' text. EXCLUDED - Furniture per boundary rules: Dressers & Sideboards, Display & Glass Cabinets, TV & Media Units (under /furniture/storage--shelves/, explicit furniture item types). EXCLUDED - Wall Decor/Furniture boundary: Shelves & Shelving Systems (2301 items; sample products are decorative/display wall shelving e.g. String shelf system, wall ledges, not utility storage shelving). EXCLUDED - decorative, not storage: Clothes Hooks & Hangers (533; sample is mostly single decorative wall hooks e.g. 'Mushroom hook', 'Lemon hook'). EXCLUDED - waste disposal, not organization: Pedal Bins (265) and Waste Paper Baskets & Bins (50). EXCLUDED - bathroom fixture hardware, not a container: Towel Rails & Holders (34). EXCLUDED - personal dressing aid, not storage: Shoehorn (17). EXCLUDED - kitchen accessory, not general storage: Knife Blocks (sits under kitchen-knives--accessories, not kitchen-storage). EXCLUDED - rug accessory/padding, not a textile floor covering itself: Carpet Underlay. EXCLUDED throughout both categories - shop-by-color/shop-by-size/shop-by-material filter-chip pages found in each category's own subcategory strip (e.g. beige-rugs, black-throws, rugs-140x200, cotton-curtains, linen-fabric, black-storage-basket, brass-umbrella-stand, grey-shelf, brass-shelf, teak-shelf): these are attribute-filtered slices of the same underlying product pool as their parent/sibling category (heavy overlap), not distinct catalogued product types, so recording them would create quantity-overlap noise and near-duplicate rows; only genuine product-type subcategory nodes were recorded. This is a judgment call, flagged where the line was least clear (Wool Rugs and Plastic Rugs marked LOW; Fringe & Deep Pile Rugs, Jute & Natural Fibre Rugs, Woven Cotton Rugs, Round Rugs marked MEDIUM).
